raw_segments.text: Cymbeline, O rare instinct, when shall I hear all through?
This fierce abridgment hath to its circumstantial branches which distinction should be rich
Where, how lived you, and when came you to serve our Roman captive?
How parted with your brothers, how first met them, why fled you from the court and wither?
These and your three motives to the battle with I know not how much more should be demanded,
and all the other by dependences from chance to chance, but nor the time nor place will
See posthumous anchors upon Imogen, and she like harmless lightning throws her eye on
him, her brothers me, her master, hitting each object with a joy.
The counter change is severly in all.
Let's quit this ground and smoke the temple with our sacrifices.
